confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors use Beijing-specific aggregated or crowd-sourced figures (Numbeo, Expatistan, cost-of-living pages) dated 2024 to 2026, not July 2026 specifically. Local beer sources conflict widely (about 8 to 29 yuan by venue type), so beer is a restaurant-level midpoint. No restaurant wine-by-the-glass price was found; wine_glass is about 3.3 times the beer anchor, plausibility-checked against shop bottle prices of 70 to 100 yuan. Cocktail is a midpoint across Expatistan and Citiesinsider-style figures. Yuan values use an approximate 6.75 yuan per USD, not an official rate. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches were run and no booking pages or listings were inspected. The FX figure comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; the F11 spreadsheet was not opened, and a 19 November 2026 observation may exist.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy was used. Food and drink anchors are Beijing-specific, except wine_glass, which is derived from the local beer relationship because no direct restaurant price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic Beijing estimates.
